scholarships.description: Merit-based undergraduate award based on academic record and SAT/ACT performance.

scholarships.description: Ten annual scholarships for students committed to visual, written, or performance arts across four undergraduate years.

campuses.text: Основной кампус в центре города Эри — все три колледжа, библиотека, спортивный комплекс, студенческие общежития.

campuses.title: Ruskin Campus (Florida)
campuses.text: Докторский кампус в Флориде, открытый в 2015 году, специализируется на программах Doctor of Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy и Physician Assistant.

paragraphs: Gannon University is a private Catholic university founded in 1925 in Erie, Pennsylvania. With an enrolment of approximately 4,200 students, it occupies a compact urban campus in downtown Erie spread across several city blocks between Peach and Myrtle Streets. Gannon traces its roots to Cathedral College, established by the Diocese of Erie, and has grown into a comprehensive doctoral-granting institution ranked No. 244 among National Universities by U.S. News & World Report in 2025.

The university is organised into three colleges — the College of Engineering and Business (including the Dahlkemper School of Business Administration), the College of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences, and the Morosky College of Health Professions and Sciences — plus the Villa Maria School of Nursing. Over 100 degrees are offered, spanning 57 undergraduate programmes and a robust set of graduate and doctoral tracks. The highly regarded health-professions programmes include Doctor of Physical Therapy, Doctor of Occupational Therapy, and Physician Assistant Studies.

Gannon's academic environment combines faith-based liberal-arts values with applied learning through extensive internship, co-op, and community-service opportunities. The student-to-faculty ratio is 12:1, ensuring personal attention, and more than 92% of students receive some form of financial assistance. The university competes in 19 NCAA Division II sports under the nickname Golden Knights.

International students are supported by the Office of English Language and Global Training, which offers ESL preparation and short-term cultural programmes. Gannon is actively expanding its regional footprint through a planned merger with Ursuline College, positioning itself to become one of the largest Catholic university systems in the northeastern United States by 2026.
paragraphsRu: Gannon University — частный католический университет, основанный в 1925 году в Эри, Пенсильвания. Около 4 200 студентов обучаются на компактном городском кампусе в центре Эри. Университет вырос из Cathedral College, учреждённого Diocese of Erie, и сегодня занимает 244-е место среди National Universities по версии U.S. News & World Report 2025.

Университет объединяет три колледжа: College of Engineering and Business (включает Dahlkemper School of Business Administration), College of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences и Morosky College of Health Professions and Sciences, а также Villa Maria School of Nursing. Предлагается более 100 степеней — 57 программ бакалавриата и широкий спектр магистерских и докторских программ. Высоко ценятся программы в сфере здравоохранения: Doctor of Physical Therapy, Doctor of Occupational Therapy и Physician Assistant Studies.

Академическая среда Gannon сочетает католические liberal-arts ценности с практическим обучением через стажировки и волонтёрство. Соотношение студентов и преподавателей — 12:1; более 92% студентов получают финансовую помощь. Университет выступает в 19 видах спорта NCAA Division II под названием Golden Knights.

Международные студенты получают поддержку через Office of English Language and Global Training — ESL-программы и краткосрочные языковые курсы. Gannon активно расширяется: слияние с Ursuline College позволит стать одной из крупнейших католических университетских систем на северо-востоке США к 2026 году.
